source_and_target_separation: Real QA recovery and synthetic migration rebuild used separate network-none containers; no migration was applied to restored real data
recovery_limits: Logical snapshot only; no PITR or recovery of the other four databases
No cluster/global role secrets copied; only referenced application role recreated NOLOGIN for isolated restore, database ACL/owners retained
Filesystem protection relies on FileVault and local account custody; artifact is NOT independently encrypted or portable as encrypted media
QA application, external object storage, secrets, jobs and E2E recovery are outside this database-only drill
Backup point must be reconsidered if QA changes before a future adoption; no future recovery point is inferred
adoption_preconditions: New PO operational order for this exact migration
Final read-only schema/data/ledger fingerprints against the recorded state
Reassess recovery point freshness if QA changed
GO/NO-GO recorded before canonical runner apply; no TEST_MODE in QA
post_commit_reversal: No automatic destructive down migration. Recovery or forward-fix requires scope/compatibility review and separate PO operational authorization.
